_bug: EARLIER DRAFT - naive greedy solver: in each outage hour, sort shops by value_per_slot and greedily pack them until capacity / fuel is hit.

_expected_fixed.note: Same fuel budget, +46 value: the greedy version locked in early-hour decisions (e.g. keeping the restaurant at slot 3 because it had value 6) and never revisited them. The MILP formulation (binary x[i,t] across all hours, single fuel budget, look-ahead across the whole day) finds the jointly optimal assignment.

_what_was_wrong: Greedy is myopic. Dropping the tailor_jamal at slot 0 looks fine locally, but the optimum reuses that kW at slot 8 for the much-higher-value restaurant. The MILP trades across the whole day at once.
